{{Top|leg}}
A '''sonoreceptor''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component that was included in the [[HK-51]] droid, a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
